subject: Remove the trailing chars of the --cluster reshard log message in valkey-cli (#2560)
reason: The change only removes the trailing ': ' from the informational 'Moving slot ...' progress message clusterManagerMoveSlot() prints on valkey-cli's stdout during --cluster reshard/fix; no server code, command reply, data path, or exit status changes, so there is no behavior a server-side experiment could observe. The one component that runs and compares valkey-cli output, valkey.action.tools, provides each build a single one-node private cluster, and every call site that prints this message requires at least two primaries: reshard aborts with 'No source nodes given' when the only node is the t
